findings.quote: Red light has a wavelength of $600$ nm in vacuum.
findings.problem: Still open from round 3, and the lead upheld it as a Blocker (final-run-rulings.md, light-and-optics round-3 ruling). Standard color bands put 600 nm in orange (about 590 to 620 nm); red starts near 620 nm. A student who learns that 600 nm is red can choose red on a wavelength-to-color item. The worked numbers in Example #4 (2.00e8 m/s, 400 nm, 5.0e14 Hz) are correct and do not depend on the color word. The split did not touch this example.
